style_when: the article explains how a system, process or stack actually works — money flows, supply chains, pipelines, an agent assembly line
prompt: Clean isometric cutaway illustration, technical drawing style, axonometric projection. An asymmetric off-centre isometric projection of a tiered mechanical sorting funnel assembly resting on a brushed steel drafting table. The top tier features a wide modular rack holding numerous frosted glass blocks, which feed downward through an intricate mid-level filtration grating into a narrow base tray containing a precise row of polished brass modules. Flat muted palette with one amber accent colour, thin consistent line weight, single directional light casting clear shadows, generous empty margin, no abstract geometry without mechanical context.
negative_prompt: garbled text, random letters, numbers, UI, watermarks, typography, text
rationale: A technical isometric illustration perfectly captures the systemic nature of the retrieval funnel, showing the structural process of narrowing wide data into precise chunks without resorting to literal software screenshots.
cue: because the funnel, not the index
subject: a tiered mechanical sorting funnel processing data blocks
core_thesis: The lookup process for an AI agent's semantic memory is a multi-stage funnel where retrieving wide and reranking is the most critical step to reduce miss rates.
core_conflict: High volume retrieval vs precision ranking costs in semantic memory
